source_history.finding: Git history contains no source-gate, corpus-object, or architecture-seed content change between the benchmark packet commit and the evaluated merge commit.

verified_facts: The original generator hashed the architecture seed as raw working-tree bytes and estimated full-context tokens from working-tree byte sizes.
The repository had no .gitattributes text policy, and clean LF and clean core.autocrlf=true materializations produced different hashes and token totals from the same Git commit.
The source paths have no Git content diff between the benchmark packet and correction merge commits.
The canonical repair normalizes CRLF and bare CR to LF, verifies every corpus-object hash, and estimates tokens from canonical text rather than encoded working-tree byte size.
unknowns: The exact working-tree EOL distribution used to create the frozen July 2 receipt is not reconstructible from the Git commit and core.autocrlf setting alone.
